title: cBioPortal aggregated study results track pack (per-study gate required)
context: cBioPortal hosts aggregated cancer genomics study results from many institutions, each with its own data license (CC-BY, ODC, or custom). This is a Priority-B source requiring per-study license verification — redistribution terms for derivative tracks vary and must be confirmed before any pack is built. The catalog-014 triage resolves which cBioPortal studies are APPROVED for redistribution; this task then builds a track pack from an approved study only.
objective: Verify redistribution rights for a specific cBioPortal study through catalog-014, run the licensegate-002 gate, and if APPROVED, build an aggregate cBioPortal study track pack on hg38.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one specific cBioPortal study is confirmed APPROVED in catalog-014 with cited redistribution terms (CC-BY, ODC, or verified custom) and permitsRedistribution: true.
Re-identification check run and PASS recorded; track is derived from aggregate study results, not individual-level genotypes.
licensegate-002 and coordgate-003 PASS artifacts committed for the selected study.
If gate FAILS or re-identification signal is found, task is marked EXCLUDED with the reason documented and no track is built.

If gate PASSES: all three browser targets emitted and render-verified; per-feature provenance records cBioPortal study ID, data version, and license; provenance completeness ≥ 90/100; not-medical-advice notice present.
resources: PLAN.md §7 (cBioPortal — Verify B → gate per study)
output: output/packs/cbioportal-study-hg38/ — aggregate track file(s), browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/ds-cbioportal-011.json (or EXCLUDED record if gate fails).
